A.name: JAL1628
lines: Ah... do you have any traffic in front of us?
Japan Air sixteen twenty-eight heavy, negative.
Japan Air sixteen twenty-eight, roger. And ah, we in sight, ah, two traffic, ah, in front of us. One mile.
Japan Air sixteen twenty-eight, roger. Can you identify the aircraft?
Ah, we are not sure, but ah, we have traffic in sight now.
Did you get another target up there, by that one-five-five-zero code?
Okay, I've got your squawk. It looks like I am getting some primary return. I don't know if it's erroneous or whatever, but...
That is affirm. We do not have anybody up there right now.
Request, ah, deviate, ah... from object.
Japan Air sixteen twenty-eight heavy, you're broken. Say again.
It's, ah... I think, ah... very quite big... plane.
Japan Air sixteen twenty-eight heavy, do you still have your traffic?

B.name: LockedInside
lines: Nine one one, what's your emergency?
[panicked, breathing hard] There's someone in my house! Please... please, he's inside!
Okay ma'am, I need your address.
[crying, panicked] Four eighteen Birch Hollow Road. Please hurry!
Officers are on the way. Where are you right now?
[frightened whisper, shaky breathing] Upstairs. In the bathroom. I locked the door.
Good. Stay there. Do you know who it is?
[crying, whispering fast] No! There's been a truck parked across the street all week. I called you guys on Monday!
Okay. Stay as quiet as you can for me. Can you hear him?
[sobbing, whispering] He's on the stairs... oh my God, he's coming up the stairs...
[calm, quiet, menacing, slow] Rachel... I know you're in there.
[terrified whisper, crying] He knows my name. How does he know my name?
Ma'am, they're two minutes out. Stay on the line with me. Ma'am?

C.name: BabyMonitor
lines: Nine one one, what's the address of your emergency?
[scared, shaky] Um, hi, I'm babysitting at twenty-two Carver Lane. I think someone's in the baby's room.
[panicked, fast] No, I heard him. On the baby monitor. Some man is talking to the baby. He's singing to her.
[breathing hard] Downstairs. The nursery's right at the top of the stairs.
Don't go up there. Is anyone else in the house?
[crying] No! The parents are at a wedding. It's just me and Lily.
[soft, slow whisper] Shhh... don't cry. She can't hear us.
[sobbing whisper] Oh my God, he's talking again. Can you hear that?
I hear it. Officers are almost there. Stay right where you are.
[slow whisper, very close] I can hear you too.

D.name: LastVoicemails
lines: First saved message. Friday. Eleven forty-two P.M.
[casual, a little annoyed] Hey Jess, it's me. My car just died on Route 9, like, in the middle of nowhere. I barely have signal. Call me back, okay?
[relieved, nervous laugh] Okay, some guy pulled over. He has jumper cables. He's nice, I guess. He keeps asking if I'm alone. I'll call you when I'm moving.
[whispering, scared, breathing fast] Jess, his truck didn't leave. It's parked behind me with the lights off. He's just sitting there, watching. I locked the doors. Please call me.
[crying, panicked whisper] He's at my window. He's not saying anything. He's just smiling. Jess, he's trying the door. He's trying the door!
[slow, calm whisper] She says... call her back.

E.name: WelfareCheck
lines: Unit twelve, welfare check, sixty-one Hollis Road. Neighbor says the resident hasn't been seen in two weeks, but the lights come on every night.
Twelve, on scene. Front door's wide open. Going in.
[uneasy] Dispatch, every mirror in this house is covered. Sheets, towels, tape. Every single one.
Copy, twelve. Any sign of the resident?
[quiet, tense] Negative. There's a plate on the kitchen table. The food's still warm.
Twelve, be advised, neighbor says he lived alone.
[whispering, tense] Dispatch... I hear someone walking upstairs.
Twelve, backup is six minutes out. Hold your position.
[whispering] There's a note taped to the stairs. It says... don't uncover them.
[shouting, panicked] Hey! Police! Don't move! Don't move!
Twelve? Unit twelve, status? ... Twelve, respond.

F.name: MileMarker113
lines: Breaker one-nine, anybody westbound on eighty near mile marker one-thirteen?
Yeah, I'm about ten miles back. What you got, driver?
There's a lady on the shoulder. Barefoot. White dress. Just waving at trucks. Three in the morning.
[serious] Don't stop. I'm serious. Don't you stop.
Come on, she's somebody's daughter. I'm pulling over.
[urgent] Listen to me. My buddy stopped for her last winter. Right there at one-thirteen.
[quiet] They found his rig. Engine running. Door open. Never found him.
[nervous laugh] Well, she's walking up to my door now. She's smiling. Hold on.
[confused, scared] Hey... why is she... her feet aren't touching the ground...
[shouting] Driver? Driver, you there? Come back! Come back!

G.name: InterviewRoom2
lines: This is Detective Cole, interview room two. Subject was found walking out of Pell Woods at one A.M. State your name, please.
[calm, tired] I don't remember my name.
You had a hiking permit for six people. Where are the other five?
Under the hill. There's a door in the hill. We thought it was an old mine.
And what happened in the mine?
[quiet] It wasn't a mine. It was a house. Someone lives down there. He set the table for six.
[skeptical] So why did he let you leave?
[slow, whispering] He said you'd come looking. He told me to tell you... he's setting the table for seven.
